notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.0.0

New
- Messages from E-Sys MAX now appear as a card on Home when the launcher starts online. To write to us, use Contact in About or Contact support on Home.
- Reinstalled Windows? Your licence can now be brought back with a recovery code (Licence window: Send recovery code, then Use recovery code).

Improved
- Stronger protection of E-Sys MAX and of the files it keeps on your PC.
- Fault texts: newer module generations (for example FLM3, DME2, EGS4, DKOMBI4, HU_NBT2, ACSM2) now show BMW's fault texts.
- Renewing a licence now always extends the licence you already have.
- Clearer messages when an update cannot be installed, with a link to your personal download.
- Many smaller fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
